notes:
New
• Open AI models that run on your own graphics card: nothing leaves your computer and no account or key is needed. One download, sized for your card (about 6.5 GB on a 12 GB card), asked for in Settings
• Story judgment like an editor: every line of a Long Form edit is scored for how much the video needs it (plot beats, jokes and reactions stay; logistics, rehearsal, phone-call admin and filler go). Ev
• Face and voice: Solis reads your expression (laughing, shocked, surprised, excited, angry...) at the strongest moments, and your voice's pitch and energy on every line. A real reaction gets full facec
• Points at what you point at: "look at my health", "250 coins", "that guy in the purple shirt" - Solis finds it on screen and zooms to it; when it moves, the zoom follows it (keyframed pan).
• Turn captions on in New Project or in the project's Direction panel and choose the font (any installed font), size, stroke width and color, text color, the spoken-word highlight color, ALL CAPS, shado
• Music matches the scene by how it sounds: Solis measures each track's tempo, brightness and dynamics, so it picks hype music for hype moments even when the files are named "track 07". Scene moods foll
• Reaction shots are chosen from face and voice, not only loudness.
• Start from an existing Premiere project (your cuts kept exactly); much faster transcription and scene detection on NVIDIA cards; the facecam box checked against real faces; production talk, retakes an
